analysis_protocol.family_reporting: Report every predeclared method, controls, failed/incomplete native cases and policy audits; no TEST-dependent comparator selection.

fpr_resolution.interpretation: Exploratory finite-sample design; no 1% FPR claim, statistical-power claim or population FPR guarantee.

analysis_protocol.integrity: Report actual class counts, active observed density, completion, support compliance, control failures and estimator domains. Diagnose attack/control failures before interpreting lower attack success.

primary_contrast.direction: Negative means lower observed declared-attack discrimination for adaptive; no universal privacy guarantee.

uncertainty.auc_difference: Percentile paired source-group bootstrap CI, conditional on the fitted model and fixed CAL threshold.
uncertainty.tpr_fpr: Two-sided exact95% Clopper-Pearson intervals and integer counts; report degeneracy rather than treating zero-error bootstrap as precise.
uncertainty.unit: resample TEST recording groups, preserving worlds and method pairing

utility.availability_limit: Final snapshot at H supplies no early online application utility; logical seal times are retained retrospective metadata.

fixed_query.absence: Unknown output is not filled as a zero measurement.
fixed_query.clock: Half-open[0,1000),...,[299000,300000)ms; t0 is initialization and excluded; sample boundaries belong to the next interval.
fixed_query.estimated_occupancy: Reuse occupancy.evaluate, uniform allocation in released space/time. Report conditional MAE with answered/scored coverage and the reference-available denominator, separately from exact query coverage.
fixed_query.exact_coverage_rule: Count exact only when approved released supports partition the complete query footprint and scheduled measurement times without spatial or temporal straddling, with known occupancy means. Coarse reconstruction does not count as exact coverage.
report: estimated occupancy MAE separately on its declared domain

utility.world_specific_reference: IN or OUT sampled source population respectively, not all physical people.

auxiliary.acquisition: Exact seeded retrospective sample over the full selected episode; auxiliary_selection role seed; identical bytes in IN and OUT.

auxiliary_only.features: Only approved t/x/y/cell sightings; same pair data and fixed TRAIN-only fit.

no_output.features: Same111-coordinate feature schema with no releases and identical paired auxiliary/public constants.

unprotected.expected_limit: Coincident background points can match in OUT, so AUC 1 is not required.
unprotected.scope: Explicit positive control outside the policy-protected comparator family.
unprotected.score: Fraction of permitted auxiliary exact (t,x,y,derivedcell) points present in the unprotected source observations; never match candidate class or identity.

attack_protocol.fitting: One model per method/feature/control as predeclared; fit on TRAIN only; all IN/OUT observations from a recording remain paired in the same split. No TEST-dependent score-direction flip, model choice or tuning.

model.nonconvergence: Retain model convergence/iteration/objective diagnostics; report model-dependent attack and contrast metrics NA for a nonconverged fit. Do not retune, retry with a larger budget, or silently substitute a model.

primary_features.composition: 31 scalar + 6 semantic summary + 72 taxonomy + 2 availability coordinates

attack_protocol.public_context: Same public map, coverage, taxonomy, policy bounds, cadence, horizon and approved semantic recipient channel in both labels. No raw background, GT, seeds, target/person IDs or private runtime features.

secondary_scalar_ablation.interpretation: Joint scalar-representation ablation drops semantic AND availability coordinates; it does not isolate semantic leakage.

attack_protocol.secret: Inclusion of one complete visible observation episode contribution; not person identity, physical absence or all episodes of one person.

threshold.candidate_rule: Existing unique score thresholds plus nextafter(max_score,+infinity) conservative candidate.
threshold.selection_rule: Maximize CAL TPR subject to empirical CAL FPR <= .1; ties choose lower FPR then higher threshold.
threshold.test_rule: Lock threshold before TEST; report observed TEST FPR/TPR/advantage without promising a population FPR cap.

deferred_gate: P25.4 constructs pairs and executes methods/attacks. This P25.3 freeze commits the protocol and existing code evidence only; it generates no primary source or score and does not certify the absent P25.4 components. Their implementation and validation gate must pass before primary TEST generation or inspection.

generator.command_template: Reuse pilot run_scene command, replacing only the predeclared source seed, output path and fresh UUID database namespaces; preserve all other flags.
generator.completion: Require complete GT/lifecycle/source projection checks and building-access audit, not only a horizon-complete flag.
generator.one_source_save_rule: Capture each recording once; replay exactly its saved observation bytes for every target/world/method/condition.
generator.sampling: Independent hash-derived trajectory seeds from the same declared generator law; modeled people are not independent privacy units.
generator.target_selection: One complete eligible visible observation episode with at least two observations; P25.1 hash ranking using target_selection role seed and actual source hash, before any mechanism output.

implementation_readiness.before_test_gate: Implement and validate all missing P25.4 components on synthetic/DEV/TRAIN/CAL evidence, record their code hashes and test receipts in an implementation supplement, and verify consistency with this protocol BEFORE generating or inspecting any primary TEST source or score. Do not claim absent code is frozen or silently change the declared analysis.
implementation_readiness.existing_code_scope: Hashes bind the existing feature, fitting, calibration, utility, recipient, audit and split helpers plus their local Python import dependencies. They do not certify code that has not yet been implemented.
p25_4_still_required: New primary-study orchestration enforcing the frozen grouped design, native/derived family, controls and complete failure accounting.
Validated two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson interval implementation.
Validated exact root/all-road-user occupancy-query coverage implementation distinct from the existing allocation-based occupancy estimator.
